bestBets.overview: A tricky race to kick off the card. Not an overly strong race from what we have seen from them. EPIC is resuming after 25 weeks, he looks a much more matured and stronger a horse from what we have seen in two winning trials leading into this race. Expect a positive first up effort. TSARDEAL finished a distant 2nd last start, but still showed some signs. Should be hitting peak fitness now and can give this a shake. Expecting MRS FLANDERS to be positive out of the gates from barrier 2, and roll to the front. Fitter 2nd up and looks a likely improver. OAKFIELD COLARDO was competitive in her only trial leading in.

raceTips.comment: The Wildling has been trialling well for the new stable and looks well placed over this short, sharp trip in a provincial maiden. Epic resumes a gelding on the back of having won both trials leading into the prep. He was weak at the back end of 1100m last prep so this shorter distance looks ideal. Tsardeal was solid off a wide run  beating all bar an odds on favourite at track/trip last time out. Has the benefit of a fitness edge. Mrs Flanders has scope to improve second up.
